findings.summary: Logical observation keys include transport delivery IDs, preventing receipt convergence.
findings.details: S05-T01 requires transport receipts to remain distinct while converging on one logical observation/source revision. The implemented observationKey hash includes envelope.transportDeliveryId, so a live delivery and a backfill/reconciliation delivery for the same provider object and revision nonce derive different observation keys. That violates the durable source-ledger contract and leaves the declared multiple-receipts-for-one-observation failure path unproved.
